entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have graduated from one of the many colleges, universities, and specialized schools of higher learning scattered throughout the world.

Benefit(s): Pick any two Knowledge skills. You gain a +2 bonus on checks with these two skills. If you have 10 or more ranks in one of these Knowledge skills, the bonus increases to +4 for that skill.
